title: onestack
tagline: A decentralized social platform for web3 developers to connect and help each other grow through questions and answers.
description: A decentralized social platform for web3 developers to connect and help each other. Built on top of Lens protocol, our site is a place where developers can ask questions, give answers and share advice. Continued integration will include customizable profiles, follows, search, and tags.
how_its_made: We made use of NextJS + Tailwind for our front end. Wagmi was used for wallet connection. Since most of our new to these technology, we encountered many problems which hindered our development. Although we were unable to accomplish what we wanted to accomplish due to the time constraint, we are still proud with what we have learnt and plan to continue building this project on top of the lens protocol.
